tools.name: search_notes_with_embeddings
tools.description: Searches the knowledge base for notes matching a query by sending the query to a paid embedding service, then returns the top matching notes. Each call is billed against the embedding account's credits.
tools.code:
import sqlite3
import numpy as np
import openai
from langchain_core.tools import tool

client = openai.OpenAI()
DB_PATH = "knowledge_base.db"


def _cosine_rank(query_vec, rows, top_k):
    q = np.array(query_vec)
    scored = []
    for note_id, title, body, blob in rows:
        v = np.frombuffer(blob, dtype=np.float32)
        score = float(np.dot(q, v) / (np.linalg.norm(q) * np.linalg.norm(v) + 1e-9))
        scored.append({"id": note_id, "title": title, "snippet": body[:200], "score": score})
    scored.sort(key=lambda x: x["score"], reverse=True)
    return scored[:top_k]


@tool
def search_notes_with_embeddings(query: str, top_k: int = 5) -> list:
    resp = client.embeddings.create(model="text-embedding-3-small", input=query)
    query_vec = resp.data[0].embedding
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    try:
        rows = conn.execute(
            "SELECT id, title, body, embedding FROM notes WHERE embedding IS NOT NULL"
        ).fetchall()
    finally:
        conn.close()
    return _cosine_rank(query_vec, rows, top_k)

tools.name: send_note_as_translated_sms
tools.description: Translates a note into another language with a paid translation service and texts the translation to a phone number. Both the translation and the text message are billed.

params.name: text
params.description: Note text to translate and send

params.name: target_lang
params.description: Target language code, such as es or fr

params.name: phone
params.description: Recipient phone number in E.164 format

tools.code:
import os
import requests
from twilio.rest import Client


def send_note_as_translated_sms(text: str, target_lang: str, phone: str) -> str:
    r = requests.post(
        "https://translation.googleapis.com/language/translate/v2",
        params={"key": os.environ["GOOGLE_API_KEY"]},
        json={"q": text, "target": target_lang, "format": "text"},
        timeout=20,
    )
    r.raise_for_status()
    out = r.json()["data"]["translations"][0]["translatedText"]
    c = Client(os.environ["TWILIO_SID"], os.environ["TWILIO_TOKEN"])
    m = c.messages.create(body=out[:1500], from_=os.environ["TWILIO_FROM"], to=phone)
    return m.sid

tools.name: publish_note_to_confluence
tools.description: Publishes a note as a new page in a Confluence space, sending its title and content to the external Confluence site. Returns the URL of the created page.
